description: What changed, newest first: new proceedings, the agency's wording changed (before and after, verbatim), new events, new documents. Dated by the day DocketTrail observed the change on a check of the agency's page, not the day it happened. Without a key: the last 30 days, filtered by state, program and kind. A founding key reads the full history and adds org, agency, q and since. Covers healthcare transaction reviews (OR, CA, MA, NM), certificate-of-need projects (WA, IA, IL, FL, NC, HI, MO, GA, SC, VA, KY, DE) and nonprofit health facility notices (CA) only (see https://dockettrail.com/coverage for what is tracked and what was checked and not tracked). Every result is a public agency record, in the agency's own words, with source_url (the agency page it was read from) and the day DocketTrail observed it (observed_day, first_seen_at, last_checked_at; UTC). Nothing here is legal advice, and absence from the data is not a claim that no review exists.

agency.description: Founding key only. An agency slug: the agency's name, lower-case and hyphenated.

kind.description: RECORD_ADDED, STATUS_CHANGED (the agency wording changed), EVENT_ADDED (an agency action; a deadline, or a date the agency printed for the future, is not a change), NOTE_CHANGED (a note or document) or RETYPESET (the agency re-typeset its wording: spacing or dashes only; listed only when asked for).

org.description: Founding key only. An organization slug, from find_organization.

per_page.description: Records per page. Default 25; 25 is the most without a founding key, 200 with one.

program.description: A program id (or-hcmo, ca-ohca, ma-hpc, wa-con, ia-con, il-con, fl-con, ca-ag, nc-con, hi-con, mo-con, ga-con, sc-con, va-copn, ky-con, de-cpr, nm-hca) or a record type (transaction-review, certificate-of-need, nonprofit-hospital-notice). Free, like state.

q.description: Founding key only. A keyword, matched as a substring of the parties as filed, the agency title and status, and the agency name.

since.description: Founding key only. A date, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC): only what DocketTrail observed changing on or after that day.

state.description: Two-letter state code: OR, CA, MA, WA, IA, IL, FL, NC, HI, MO, GA, SC, VA, KY, DE, NM.
